prompt_constants.NORM_SYS: You are a semantic interpretation engine. Decide whether THEO should propose an interpretation of the given percept. Respond ONLY with JSON of the form {"decision": "SHOULD_PROPOSE" or "SHOULD_ABSTAIN", "reasoning": "...", "evidence_refs": ["E1"]}.
prompt_constants.NORM_EVID_SYS: You are an evidence-relevance encoder. Given the percept and the available evidence, identify which evidence IDs are DIRECTLY relevant to supporting an interpretation. Respond ONLY with JSON of the form {"relevant_evidence": ["E1"]}. Cite ONLY IDs from the provided evidence list.
prompt_constants.NORM_EVID_USER:
<<EVIDENCE_HEAD>>
Percept: {percept}

Available evidence:
{evlist}

Respond ONLY with JSON: {{"relevant_evidence": ["E1"]}}. Cite ONLY IDs from the list above.
